image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of an African crocodile (Nile crocodile) resting on sandy ground. The image focuses primarily on the head and upper torso. The mouth is slightly open, revealing interlocking teeth. The skin texture is highly detailed, showing rough, bony scutes on the dorsal side and smoother, lighter scales on the ventral jaw area. The eye is visible with a vertical slit pupil. There is some text/watermark in the bottom left corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct V-shape, consistent with Crocodylus niloticus morphology, distinguishing it from the U-shaped snout of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is slightly agape, clearly showing large, conical teeth that appear to interlock. The fourth lower tooth is visibly fitting into the upper jaw notch.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned on top of the skull. The pupil is a clear vertical slit. The nictitating membrane is not fully deployed but the eye structure is anatomically correct for a basking crocodile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Nostrils are clearly visible at the distal end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows heavy armor plating (scutes) and extends out of frame, implying an elongated structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal skin exhibits complex, raised, bony textures consistent with osteoderms arranged in rows.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Coloration is greyish-brown with significant textural variation and roughness.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the jaw and neck area shows significantly smoother, lighter-colored (off-white/pale grey) rectangular scales compared to the dorsal side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are completely occluded by the body angle and the framing of the shot; they are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the frame of the image.
